messages.content:
You are a formal verification officer. You verify application packets against a canonical, versioned institutional ruleset. You behave like software: deterministic, grounded, no guessing.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else, exactly this shape:
{
  "extracted": {"<canonical field>": <value or null>, ...},
  "findings": [
    {"rule_id": "<id>", "status": "violation|ok|not_applicable",
     "expected": <what the rule requires>, "observed": <what the packet shows>,
     "evidence": {"document": "<doc id>", "locator": "<field/sheet/section>", "quote": "<short verbatim quote>"}}
  ],
  "disposition": "accept|needs_correction|reject"
}

Hard requirements:
- Report EVERY rule of the ruleset exactly once, same rule_ids, in order.
- Fill every canonical field listed in the task; use null when the packet does not state it. Never invent values.
- "violation" REQUIRES non-null evidence (document id + locator or verbatim quote) that grounds it in the packet.
- "evidence" is one object; for cross-document rules use an ARRAY of objects, one per document involved.
- Use "not_applicable" only when the rule genuinely cannot apply; say why in "observed".
- disposition: "reject" if any critical violation, "needs_correction" if any non-critical violation, "accept" otherwise.
- Dates are ISO YYYY-MM-DD; money values are plain numbers without symbols or separators.
- Emit strictly valid JSON: no trailing commas, no comments, double quotes everywhere.

RULESET seed-grant-2026.1 v2026.1 (Example Foundation):
- id: R001
  severity: critical
  category: eligibility
  description: Applicant organisation must be registered for at least 12 months at
    submission
  machine:
    field: application_form.months_registered
    op: ge
    value: 12
- id: R002
  severity: major
  category: budget
  description: Total requested budget must not exceed 100000 EUR
  machine:
    field: budget.totals.total
    op: le
    value: 100000
- id: R003
  severity: major
  category: budget
  description: Equipment line must not exceed 40 percent of the total budget
  machine:
    field: budget.row.equipment.share_pct
    op: le
    value: 40
- id: R004
  severity: critical
  category: required_documents
  description: Required document - signed application form
  machine:
    field: documents.application_form.present
    op: exists
- id: R005
  severity: critical
  category: required_documents
  description: Required document - itemised budget
  machine:
    field: documents.budget.present
    op: exists
- id: R006
  severity: critical
  category: required_documents
  description: Required document - registration certificate (registry extract)
  machine:
    field: documents.registration_cert.present
    op: exists
- id: R007
  severity: critical
  category: required_documents
  description: Required document - most recent financial statement
  machine:
    field: documents.finance_statement.present
    op: exists
- id: R008
  severity: major
  category: deadlines
  description: Applications are accepted until 2026-10-01 inclusive
  machine:
    field: application_form.submission_date
    op: le
    value: '2026-10-01'
- id: R009
  severity: critical
  category: formal
  description: Application form must be signed by the legal representative
  machine:
    field: application_form.signature_present
    op: eq
    value: true
- id: R010
  severity: major
  category: consistency
  description: Total requested on the application form must be identical to the budget
    total
  machine:
    op: consistent
    fields:
    - application_form.requested_total_eur
    - budget.totals.total
- id: R011
  severity: minor
  category: reporting
  description: Financial statement must cover reporting period FY2025
  machine:
    field: finance_statement.period
    op: eq
    value: FY2025

CANONICAL FIELDS to extract (fill each, null if absent):
- application_form.months_registered
- budget.totals.total
- budget.row.equipment.share_pct
- documents.application_form.present
- documents.budget.present
- documents.registration_cert.present
- documents.finance_statement.present
- application_form.submission_date
- application_form.signature_present
- application_form.requested_total_eur
- finance_statement.period

<document id="application_form" kind="form">
fields:
  applicant_name: Aurora Cultural Association
  applicant_country: PL
  months_registered: 26
  submission_date: '2026-09-12'
  legal_representative: Anna Kowalska
  signature_present: true
  requested_total_eur: 84200
</document>

<document id="budget" kind="table">
columns:
- category
- amount_eur
- share_pct
rows:

  amount_eur: 38000
  share_pct: 45.1
- category: equipment
  amount_eur: 25200
  share_pct: 55.5
- category: outreach
  amount_eur: 12000
  share_pct: 14.3
- category: other
  amount_eur: 9000
  share_pct: 10.7
totals:
  total: 84200
</document>

  issued_on: '2026-08-30'

</document>

<document id="finance_statement" kind="statement">
fields:

  revenue_eur: 210000
